'''Altikar IV''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Altikar system/Legends|Altikar system]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] Altikar IV became the home to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jhor-Kai]]. Through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], he appeared in the dreams of a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] named [[Sha'lia]]. She eventually escaped from her owner and traveled to the planet with the aid of fellow escapee [[Goort]]. On the planet, Jhor-Kai trained Sha'lia in the Force, and Goort in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] piloting. After a short time, however, Imperials tracked the Jedi to the planet and [[Skirmish on Altikar IV|attacked]]. Jhor-Kai was killed by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] buying time for his students to escape the planet.<ref name="COL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Altikar IV was created for the [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] ''[[Child of Light saga]]'' scenario, ''[[Child of Light]]'', published in [[2000]]. Its system was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.
